definitions.gloss: wakame, a type of edible seaweed
definitions.explanation: A brown seaweed widely used in Japanese cuisine, especially in miso soup and salads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わかめ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put wakame in miso soup.

examples.japanese: わかめ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れ→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Wakame is rich in nutrients and easy to incorporate into daily meals.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. The kanji {若布|わかめ} or {和布|わかめ} exists but is uncommon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- わかめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ (wakame miso soup)
- わかめ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧ (wakame salad)
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧わかめ (dried wakame)
- わかめ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to rehydrate dried wakame)

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the most commonly eaten seaweeds in Japan. Dried wakame (⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧わかめ) is a pantry staple that can be rehydrated quickly. Distinct from ⟦{昆布|こんぶ}→昆布：04934_konbu⟧ (kelp) and ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ (nori).
